subject: Supply Chain & Logistics
title: Geopolitical Risks
description: A short lesson to help you apply Geopolitical Risks.

hook.text: New tariffs on Chinese goods appeared overnight. Supply chains built over decades became uneconomical instantly.

buildup.text: Trade wars, sanctions, political instability, and conflicts can block supply routes or raise costs suddenly.

discovery.text: Geopolitical risk is hard to predict but easy to prepare for—through diversification and scenario planning.

twist.text: Companies chasing the lowest-cost country often concentrate supply in geopolitically risky regions.

climax.text: Russia's invasion of Ukraine disrupted global grain, energy, and neon gas supplies—affecting unrelated industries.

punchline.text: Politics moves borders. Supply chains must move with them.

quiz.question: How should companies prepare for geopolitical risk?
options: Diversify suppliers and use scenario planning
